name: The arrival joust
text: An open-air jousting list at the edge of a carnival city in a warm, lush river delta. Painted timber false-front buildings, striped canvas tents, rigging and bunting, a raised plank boardwalk packed with spectators. At the centre a knight is thrown backwards off his horse, a splintered lance caught at his throat, blood spraying; the winning rider gallops past. The crowd roars with delight, raising cups and waving pennants. One traveller at the rail in plain road clothes recoils in horror, the only person not cheering.

name: The self-crowned emperor
text: Head-and-shoulders portrait of a heavy, jowly middle-aged human man playing at being an emperor. He sweats under a brand-new gold crown made to look ancient, slightly too big for his head. Furs, gold chains, rings and jewels are piled on past all taste. His regal pose is studied and effortful, copied from paintings, but his eyes dart sideways, nervous. Grotesque, pitiable and frightened underneath. Gaudy torchlit hall behind him.

name: The mage city
text: A pale, glassy city on a desert mesa under a hard blue sky. Sleek, flowing, gravity-defying towers in the spirit of Zaha Hadid, built from fused sand-glass and bone-coloured vitrified stone: spires too slender to stand, cantilevers over nothing, a library whose upper floors are wider than its base. Floating bridges and disconnected floating staircases hang in the air between inward-facing towers. At the centre stands an ornate grand building with no visible door. Far below, around the mesa's foot, humble round mud-brick desert domes. Empty desert to the horizon.

name: The orb and the left shoe
text: A sleek, pale, curving council chamber. Three elderly mages in grand robes sit at a high curved bench: a haughty, vain man; a prim woman fussing with a scroll; a drowsy old man half-asleep. Before them, a glowing crystal orb on a stone plinth, and beside it a faint shimmer in the air. The vain mage stands, solemnly holding out his own left shoe to the orb with both hands, one foot in a stocking, utterly serious. Pompous, absurd, deadpan.

name: The elven plateau
text: A raised green tableland above the clouds, cradling a still, mirror-like sacred lake. Around it an elven capital in the spirit of Gaudí's Sagrada Família: organic, maximalist towers that look grown rather than built, every surface blooming with ornament. Manicured ornamental gardens and terraced vineyards. A graceful Greek-style stone aqueduct carries the lake's water into the city's fountains. Far below the plateau's edge, through haze, a church city clings to the mountain's flank.

name: The great hall and the wall of names
text: Interior of a northern great hall in deep winter. Patched make-do construction: mismatched old and new timber lashed together, hide stretched over gaps, stone at the base. A long central fire pit is the only warmth. Antlers, furs and beast skulls hang as trophies; drying herbs and roots hang from the rafters; runes are carved on the beams and lintels; bone charms hang by the door. One whole wall is a smoke-darkened timber board carved top to bottom with rows of runic names. Palette of dark browns, greys, black, undyed wool and bone-white; nothing dyed.

name: The rooted city wakes
text: A vast underground ruined city of advanced brass-and-iron machinery (gears, pistons, pipes, great clockwork engines) half-swallowed by pale roots, vines and furred grey fungus. Faint lights still glow; a few gears still turn. In the foreground a heavy wooden table has lurched off the floor and is hurtling at the viewer, driven by thick roots wrapped through its legs, spores bursting off it. Behind it the room is waking: a chair twitching, a fan blade starting to swing.

name: The skin comes off
text: A torchlit witch's den: low timber and stone, runes carved into the walls, drying herbs and bone charms, a circle of blood-red runes on the floor. At the centre, a kindly-looking village healer in fur and undyed wool is splitting open down the middle like a shed skin. Out of it unfolds a towering, otherworldly chimera of mismatched parts: arms of different sizes, tentacles, extra tongues, joints bending the wrong way. The empty human skin hangs off it like a coat. Menacing, strange, wrong.
